title: Grateful Dead Live at Seminole Indian Village on 1969-05-23

ai_review.summary: Stunning 1969 soundboard captures a smoking Dark Star and glorious Morning Dew with crystal‑clear mix and high‑energy performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is an immaculate soundboard capture – every instrument rings out, the low end is punchy and Garcia’s vocals are vivid. Musically the show shines thanks to a monster Dark Star, a soaring Morning Dew, tight St. Stephen and a thumping “11”, delivering a high‑octane late‑’60s Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are 4–5 stars, repeatedly praising both the superb soundboard quality and the exceptional performances; the consensus is overwhelmingly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with excellent instrument separation; vocals are present and juicy, low end strong, cymbal crashes audible. No noted drop‑outs or muffling.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show builds from a powerful Dark Star into an inspiring second jam, with the Morning Dew and St. Stephen providing high points; overall pacing is tight and exciting.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia in fine voice with great guitar tone; his playing highlighted as 'sweet' and 'fine'.
band_member_comments.Phil: Thumping bass noted – “1969 umph”, strong bass sequence on "11".
band_member_comments.Drums: Amazing whooshing cymbal crashes into the second jam, drum presence clear throughout.
